rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name and ZIP and fetched user and order details, which aligns with policy. However, it executed order-changing actions (returning three items on one order and exchanging an item on another) without any explicit user confirmation shown. The policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it. The final message also lacks a clear summary of what was processed, refund details, or confirmation prompts. Therefore, despite taking actions that broadly match the user’s intent (returns of two skateboards and a smartwatch, exchange of the e-reader if available), the absence of confirmation before writing constitutes a policy violation, leading to a fail.
